Existing Kotlin convenience adapter commits key and authority in separate transactions, requiring receipts/recovery for A1a/A1b. An approved shared-connection invocation of both existing canonical append functions could make Phase A atomic, but no such composer is implemented/proven here.

Materialize22-field ApprovalManifest using frozen literal/source inputs plus actual IDs/T0; encode/digest/sign in memory once; independently verify JCA+canonical scope. Local signature verification does not mean V041 durable accepted attestation.

Canonical trusted ADMIN, same actual connection for all B operations. Ensure finite remaining window; build approved NOT_READY/preflight prerequisites; readiness-key FK cycle may defer as source specifies.

Insert REGISTERED lifecycle, NULL current-attempt pointer with no claim, NOT_CREATED delivery, NOT_STARTED reconciliation and NONE result. Do not create accepted evidence, command principal/credential/grant/decision, sessions or READY.

Do not prematurely retire after successful binding if later V041 acceptance needs active key/authority.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.offline_internal_canonical_spki_ed25519_verify(subject_public_key_info_der bytea, canonical_signature_preimage_bytes bytea, signature_bytes bytea)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN offline_crypto.canonical_spki_ed25519_verify($1,$2,$3);
END;
$function$
